$captionDoc: Captions ruled 27 Sep 2026 (copy review, claude/nuuly-review-s03.md): house caption style, the lead is the app's name and the tail says what it does; the tiles keep their journey order. Triage left the launcher tail (an app never built before Paul left). Alts were rewritten 19 Aug when the tiles became padded 16:10 whole frames. apps-07's alt names the W3 cycle deliberately: the 15 Aug Option B ruling makes tw-done's resolved label publishable and bars only tw-wet's fibre mapping, so withholding it would give a screen-reader user less than a sighted one for no protection.

images.alt: The launcher: six circular tiles for Fingerprint, Test wash, Measure, Inspections, Returns and Packing, with Returns marked offline and a second page below.

caption.tail: Each station opens the one job it has today.

images.alt: Receiving: a purchase order grid with one slot filled, beside a garment card reading Received 2, Ordered 10.

caption.tail: Counts new stock in against the order, piece by piece.

images.alt: Returning: the Scan fingerprint step, with a prompt to scan a garment from the bag.

caption.tail: One scan from the bag pulls up the whole return.

images.alt: Inspection: a returned garment beside a grid of damage types with stain selected, and pass and fail as the two verdicts.

caption.tail: Names the damage from a set list, then passes or fails it.

images.alt: Packing: Pick a garment bag, with small, medium and large bags and the large one chosen, above Weigh this package.

caption.tail: Offers three bag sizes for the order, then weighs it.

images.alt: Test Wash: the wash cycle for a new style set to W3, delicate lights, with the dry clean alternative unset.

caption.tail: Sets one wash cycle for every size of a style.

images.alt: Measure: the garment type list open, grouped into tops and bottoms.

caption.tail: The garment type decides what gets measured.
